verdict.rationale: SES documents a Templated message type whose personalization tags are replaced with values you supply at send time, which covers basic merge fields. Nothing in the evidence documents the templating language itself, conditionals, loops, or any preview/test-render capability. Community comments that SES users must handle templating themselves are general and do not concretely contradict the documented templated sends. Missing for 10: documented template syntax, conditionals, loops, preview/test-render of templates, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can personalize emails with a documented templating language — merge fields, conditionals, loops — and preview or test-render a template before sending

citations.quote: Templated – A message that contains personalization tags. When you send this type of email, Amazon SES API v2 automatically replaces the tags with values that you specify.
You can use the Amazon SES API v2 to send the following types of messages: Simple ... Raw ... Templated
